intro: Bulgaria stretches from the Danube to the Black Sea, crossed by mountain ranges and famous for its Valley of Roses.

chapters.title: Mountains, plains and sea
text: The Danube forms most of the border with Romania. The Balkan Mountains run across the middle of the country, and in the south-west the Rila and Pirin ranges rise high; Musala, in Rila, is the highest peak in the Balkans. The Black Sea coast has long sandy beaches.
Bulgaria borders Romania, Serbia, North Macedonia, Greece and Turkey.

chapters.title: Roses and rocks
text: In the Valley of Roses around Kazanlak, farmers grow roses for rose oil used in perfumes. The Seven Rila Lakes and the strange rock towers of Belogradchik are natural wonders.

keyTerms.meaning: A precious oil made from rose petals, used in perfume.
